title: Warding Totem Bell
description: Totem of Undying to Warding Bell from Silksong plus sound
body:
This resource pack changes the **texture** and **sound** of the `Totem of Undying` to the `Guard Bell` from _Hollow Knight: Silksong_.

In the future, I plan to change the particles and perhaps create a more beautiful bell texture.

This is my first project, by the way.
